Throughout their career, Lionel Messi has won 54 titles: MLS (2025), Campeones Cup (2026), and Leagues Cup (2023) with Inter Miami CF, Trophée des Champions (2022/2023) and Ligue 1 (2022/2023, 2021/2022) with Paris Saint-Germain, Copa America (2024 USA, 2021 Brazil), World Cup (2022 Qatar), and CONMEBOL/UEFA Finalissima (2022) with Argentina, Supercopa de Catalunya (2018), LaLiga (2018/2019, 2017/2018, 2015/2016, 2014/2015, 2012/2013, 2010/2011, 2009/2010, 2008/2009, 2005/2006, 2004/2005), Champions League (2014/2015, 2010/2011, 2008/2009, 2005/2006), Copa Catalunya (2013/2014), Audi Cup (2011), UEFA Super Cup (2015/2016, 2011/2012, 2009/2010), Copa del Rey (2020/2021, 2017/2018, 2016/2017, 2015/2016, 2014/2015, 2011/2012, 2008/2009), FIFA Club World Cup (2015 Japan, 2011 Japan, 2009 UAE), Trofeo Joan Gamper (2020, 2019, 2018, 2017, 2016), and Supercopa de España (2018/2019, 2016/2017, 2013/2014, 2011/2012, 2010/2011, 2009/2010, 2006/2007, 2005/2006) with Barcelona, and Summer Olympics (2008 Beijing) with Argentina U23.

Lionel Messi has competed in Major League Soccer, CONCACAF Champions Cup, World Cup, Leagues Cup, Campeones Cup, FIFA Club World Cup, Copa America, US Open Cup, World Cup CONMEBOL qualification, Ligue 1, Coupe de France, Champions League, Finalissima, Super Cup, LaLiga, Copa del Rey, and Super Cup.
